name: Oath of the Ancients (Paladin Subclass - 2024)
description: Paladins of the Oath of the Ancients preserve the light and joy in the world, kindling the hope of the helpless and opposing despair.
tenets: Kindle the Light: Through acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world.
Shelter the Light: Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it.
Preserve Your Own Light: Delight in song and laughter, in beauty, and in art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can_t preserve it in the world.
Be the Light: Be a beacon against despair. Let the light of your joy and courage shine forth in all your deeds.
oath_spells_note: Oath of the Ancients Spells are always prepared and do not count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

3.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells (Level 3)
3.description: Always have Speak with Animals, Ensnaring Strike prepared.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Nature_s Wrath
3.description: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to invoke primeval forces to ensnare a foe. Choose one creature you can see within 10 feet of you. That creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained by spectral vines for 1 minute. The restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

5.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells (Level 5)
5.description: Always have Moonbeam, Misty Step prepared.

7.name: Aura of Warding
7.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to damage from spells. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

7.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells (Level 7)
7.description: Always have Plant Growth, Protection from Energy prepared.

9.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells (Level 9)
9.description: Always have Ice Storm, Stone Skin prepared.

13.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells (Level 13)
13.description: Always have Commune with Nature, Tree Stride prepared.

15.name: Undying Sentinel
15.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points and are not killed outright, you can choose to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this ability, you can_t use it again until you finish a long rest. Additionally, you suffer none of the drawbacks of old age, and you can_t be aged magically.

20.name: Elder Champion
20.description: As a bonus action, you can assume the form of an ancient force of nature for 1 minute. Benefits: Regain 10 HP at the start of your turns. Paladin spells with a casting time of 1 action can be cast as a bonus action. Enemies within 10 feet of you have disadvantage on saving throws against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity options. Once you use this feature, you can_t use it again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to use it again.
